svg.title: Draw it yourself: Week 30
svg.desc: A large empty framed panel with a dashed inner border and faint centre text reading your diagram here. The prompt asks the learner to draw two columns of very different sizes, the gaps before and after scaling, and to mark which column was shouting over the other.
svg.text: Two columns, two very different sizes, and what scaling does to them.
Draw the gaps before scaling and after, and mark which column was shouting.
